name: AMO-Bench-Int
description: AMO-Bench-Int is a benchmark of integer arithmetic and numerical reasoning problems designed to evaluate model capability on exact integer computation and related reasoning steps. It contains a variety of integer-focused problem templates to test precision, robustness to paraphrase, and stepwise calculation. The benchmark emphasizes exact numeric outputs rather than free-form explanation.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset by Haoran Li used for arithmetic/int reasoning evaluations with modest community adoption.
